summary: Prioritize AI use cases, assess risk, and build an executive-ready roadmap. Explore practical frameworks and tools in this five-day course.
lede: AI strategy training helps business, technology, and governance professionals turn priorities into responsible AI portfolios. It covers prioritizing use cases by value, feasibility, data readiness, and risk, then shaping business cases and phased roadmaps. Participants also practise assigning governance roles, assessing lifecycle risks, and defining KPIs and executive dashboard measures, with a focus on operational planning rather than technical implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape AI investment, portfolio choices, governance, or delivery and need to connect business priorities with responsible AI decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational business priorities or technology initiatives is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on strategy, governance, and planning artefacts.
